category: agent platform API, one-time free API call quota, daily message credits in the app

free_tier.stated: a free quota of 30 Coze API calls for each registered account, counted over all APIs of all agents, then Coze tokens must be bought; separately 10 message credits a day in the app, valid only for the day
free_tier.notes: the 10 credits a day cover use in the Coze app and not API calls; the free API quota is 30 calls and is not stated to reset

tooling: HTTP API that chats with an agent published as an API service, authenticated with a personal access token; the model is the one configured in the agent
chaining: buying Coze tokens raises the Chat API rate limit tier at 2M accumulated tokens

limits.value: 30 free Coze API calls per account, then Coze tokens are deducted
under 2M accumulated purchased Coze tokens: 5 requests per second, 300 per minute, 20,000 per day

binding_note: 30 free calls is the whole free API allowance
